story.title: The Weight of a Second
story.logline: A man who buys extra time by giving away his memories discovers what he has actually forgotten.
story.twist: The memories he gave away were not his past, but his future.
story.ending: If tomorrow is already gone, what are you waiting for today?

scenes.narration: I bought three extra hours of life today, and the price was my first kiss.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Leo, a 25-year-old man with messy dark hair and a worn denim jacket, sitting in a dimly lit neon-soaked clinic.

scenes.narration: The time broker smiled, sliding a glowing glass marble across the metal desk. My chest felt instantly lighter.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of Leo, same dark hair and denim jacket, looking at a glowing blue marble on a cold steel desk.

scenes.narration: Everyone in this city trades their past to cheat the clock. A childhood pet for a Tuesday afternoon.
scenes.visual_prompt: Wide shot of Leo walking down a crowded urban street at dusk, wearing his denim jacket, people rushing past him.

scenes.narration: A college graduation for a quiet Sunday morning. We are all dying to live, by forgetting how.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Leo, messy dark hair, touching his temple as a wave of sudden emptiness crosses his face.

scenes.narration: Tonight, I needed a whole week. To finish the painting that would finally make me immortal.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of Leo in a messy art studio wearing his denim jacket, staring blankly at a half-finished canvas.

scenes.narration: The broker didn't want memories of my youth this time. He wanted something much heavier.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Leo, same dark hair and denim jacket, looking directly into the lens with sudden dread.

scenes.narration: He wanted the day I turn thirty. The entire day. My absolute peak. I signed the contract without blinking.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of Leo signing a glowing digital pad in the dark clinic, wearing his worn denim jacket.

scenes.narration: Instantly, my mind violently lurched forward. I bypassed my thirtieth birthday entirely, landing right after it.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Leo, messy dark hair, gasping for air as if waking from a nightmare in his studio.

scenes.narration: The painting on my easel was finished. A masterpiece. But my hands were old, trembling, and frail.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of Leo, now looking aged with graying hair but still in the same denim jacket, staring at a completed painting.
scenes.camera: Slow pan from hands to face

scenes.narration: I never lived the day I became great. If tomorrow is already gone, what are you waiting for today?
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of older Leo in his denim jacket shedding a single tear under a harsh, flickering studio light.

caption.hook: He traded tomorrow to survive today.
caption.title: The Weight of a Second
caption.caption:
Every extra second cost him a piece of his yesterday. But when the ledger finally cleared, he realized the tragedy wasn't what he'd lost behind him—it was what hadn't happened yet.

Would you trade your future to stay in the present?
